value.title: Infiniti Desideri Terreni
value.synopsis: Qualche tempo prima degli eventi della serie TV Genshiken: Seconda Stagione, Susanna e Angela visitano il Giappone durante la notte di Capodanno. Susanna rimane a casa di Ogiue mentre progetta di studiare nella stessa Università. I membri originali di Genshiken organizzano una visita al santuario di Capodanno con i loro ospiti americani.

value.title: Ramen Tenshi Pretty Menma
value.synopsis: Crossover Series between Genshiken 2 & Kujibiki Unbalance The plot revolves around Kaoru Torigara, only son of a ramen shop owner, who is going to renovate his inherited ramen shop. He discovers that his shop has a guardian angel named Pretty Menma. Pretty Menma tells Kaoru that his dead father's intention is making him succeed in the "Food King Wars", a battle of restaurants around the world that is held every 4 years. Kaoru and Menma must help each other to go through the struggles of the "Food King Wars".
